reviews.title: You’ll pay a lot per call.
reviews.text:
I purchased a 30 day number and assumed that I would be able to use it for a few calls a week in a relatively unrestricted way. 

You actually have to ***pay per call*** based on how long the call is. It will not tell you that nor say how expensive a call is. You can only see it in your expenses tab. I didn’t know I was paying per call until I was rummaging around in the app.

There is a daily check in feature to get some free credits which is nice, but I estimate that the max possible free daily credit you can get would cover about a ~6 min call and you have to work up to that. You also have to watch two relatively long ads to check in.

I think that when you purchase the 30 day number, you get 400 credits which would be like 40 minutes of calling max. 

Also, you cannot turn off auto repay. There is a toggle (button) in the app to do so, but if you click it, nothing changes. 

The UI is fine nothing special. 

Kind of shady overall, will not be purchasing again. I would say it is like a 1.5/5 stars.

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text:
This VoIP app promises seamless calling and SMS functionality, but in reality it delivers very little of what it advertises. From the moment you open it, the experience feels unfinished and poorly thought out. Basic features that should work out of the box instead require constant troubleshooting, which quickly becomes frustrating.

Call quality is one of the biggest disappointments. Audio frequently cuts out, calls drop without warning, and there is noticeable delay even on a strong internet connection. For an app whose main purpose is voice communication, failing at this core function makes it practically unusable.

The SMS feature is no better. Messages are often delayed, sometimes never delivered at all, and there is no clear indication of whether a message was successfully sent. On several occasions, incoming texts appeared hours late or not at all, making the app unreliable for any real communication.

The user interface adds to the frustration. It feels cluttered yet somehow missing essential options, with confusing menus and inconsistent behavior. Notifications are unreliable, settings don’t always save properly, and the app occasionally freezes or crashes for no apparent reason.
